data.one_liner: Code generation of .proto and Dart mapper classes for using PODOs with gRPC.
data.what_it_does: Generates Protocol Buffer .proto files and Dart mapper classes from plain old Dart objects annotated with @proto and @ProtoField. It facilitates seamless serialization between your custom Dart models and gRPC messages, including support for polymorphism and well-known types.
use_when: You are building a Dart/Flutter application that communicates with gRPC backends
You want to avoid manually writing boilerplate mapping code between Dart models and gRPC protobuf messages
avoid_when: You are not using gRPC or protocol buffers in your project
You prefer writing manual serialization mappers instead of relying on build_runner
strengths: Significantly reduces boilerplate for gRPC model mapping
Supports polymorphism and class inheritance mapping
Compatible with primary constructors and Google Well Known Types
weaknesses: Requires maintaining external tools like protoc compiler and build_runner
Additional setup steps required outside of standard pub dependency management
data.setup_notes: Requires adding proto_annotations and proto_generator, installing the Dart protoc plugin, running build_runner, and compiling proto files manually using protoc.
